steps.title: Build the profile
steps.text: Use Automatic Setup to build the Apple profile. Scan the QR with the camera or open the link in Safari.

steps.title: Download the profile
steps.text: When Safari asks, tap Allow. The profile downloads into Settings.

steps.title: Install the profile
steps.text: Open Settings, General, VPN & Device Management. Pick the profile, install it and enter the device passcode.

steps.title: Select it for DNS
steps.text: Open Settings, General, VPN & Device Management, DNS and select this profile.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.text: A few seconds after saving, run this check to see that the device uses this Endpoint.
